summary: The change adds a 64 KiB global cap in `readJson`, applies 16 KiB and 32 KiB endpoint-specific limits across all current JSON routes, rejects declared and streamed overruns with 413, and tests declared, chunked, and valid boundary cases.

evidence: src/http.ts defines MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES, SMALL_JSON_BODY_BYTES and ADMIN_JSON_BODY_BYTES and streams bodies while checking Content-Length before reading and cancelling streamed overruns.
src/passport.ts applies SMALL or MAX limits to every readJson call site and maps RequestBodyTooLargeError to a 413 payload_too_large response with CORS, HSTS and session refresh.
tests/bun_test.ts covers declared Content-Length overrun, chunked streamed overrun with cancellation, a valid boundary-sized request, and preserved rotated session cookies.
